source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 26, 2026, cover page
source.quote: As of October 23, 2026, the registrant had outstanding 5,315 million shares of common stock.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as INTC. The Q3 2026 10-Q cover (filed October 30, 2026) is the latest count and is stated rounded to millions. It is about 6% above the FY2025 10-K cover (4,995 million at January 16, 2026), and the 10-Q cash-flow statement shows a public offering of common stock in 2026 ("Net proceeds from public offering of common stock 22,617" million).
